preconditions.description: The number of participants m and remembered top n must satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 3000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= points <= 2 * m for points in top_points)
preconditions.description: Each remembered point value in top_points is non-negative and does not exceed 2·m.
The input contains exactly n remembered point values.
The remembered point values are provided in non-ascending order.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'no' or (stdout.strip() == 'yes' and len(tournament_table) == m and all(len(row) == m for row in tournament_table))
postconditions.description: If no valid tournament exists, output 'no'. Otherwise, output 'yes' followed by an m×m tournament table where each row is a string of length m with characters 'X', 'W', 'D', or 'L'.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and all(tournament_table[i][i] == 'X' for i in range(m))
postconditions.description: The main diagonal of the tournament table must consist exclusively of 'X' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and all(tournament_table[i][j] in {'W', 'L', 'D'} for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j)
postconditions.description: Off-diagonal entries must be 'W', 'L', or 'D', representing win, loss, or draw, respectively.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and all(tournament_table[i][j] == 'L' if tournament_table[j][i] == 'W' else True for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j)
postconditions.description: For every pair of players i and j, if i beats j ('W'), then j must lose to i ('L'), and vice versa.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and all(tournament_table[i][j] == 'D' if tournament_table[j][i] == 'D' else True for i in range(m) for j in range(m) if i != j)
postconditions.description: For every pair of players i and j, if the game is a draw ('D'), the result must be symmetric.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'yes' and (sorted([sum(tournament_table[i][j] == 'W' * 2 + tournament_table[i][j] == 'D' * 1 for j in range(m)) for i in range(m)], reverse=True)[:n] == top_points)
postconditions.description: The top n sorted point totals of the tournament must match the remembered top_points.
